description: Land Title Settlement Department - Main area in Vavuniya, Oddusudan D/S Division, Vavuniya District
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land settlement matters under the Land Settlement Ordinance. It contains final orders for settling specific land parcels in Vavuniya District, including detailed schedules showing land lots, extents, and on whom the lands are settled (either to The State or to named individuals). The content focuses entirely on land title registration and property settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
